definitions.eligible: Existing rank_candidates.annotate usable_screen rules; no additional source-quality claims.
definitions.strong: Eligible record distance_planck_uv >= 0.01; exploratory threshold, no false-discovery probability.
definitions.representative: Calibration, instrument preference, S/N and source URL; no selection by anomaly magnitude.
definitions.calibration: Existing full-original-grid SDSS gri then PS1 gri fallback. Floor 0.02 mag; reject residual >=0.15 mag or absolute tilt >=0.25 mag/1000 A. Sky masking follows the fit for colour integration.
definitions.new_units: Strict native-pixel comparison; astrophysical association, native quality and calibration have separate fields.
